name: APP-CHMINACA RM
summary: PX-3 (also known as APP-CHMINACA) is an indazole-based synthetic cannabinoid.6 nM and was originally developed by Pfizer in 2009 as an analgesic medication.

pharmacology.text: It is a potent agonist of the CB1 receptor with a binding affinity of Ki = 47.6 nM and was originally developed by Pfizer in 2009 as an analgesic medication.

uses.text: It is a potent agonist of the CB1 receptor with a binding affinity of Ki = 47.6 nM and was originally developed by Pfizer in 2009 as an analgesic medication.

sideEffects.en: Little is known about it in people. Drugs of its class, the synthetic cannabinoids, can cause a racing heart, agitation, vomiting, confusion, seizures and psychosis.
sideEffects.zh: 它對人體的影響所知甚少。同類的合成大麻素可能造成心跳急促、躁動、嘔吐、混亂、癲癇發作與精神病。
sideEffects.zhHans: 它对人体的影响所知甚少。同类的合成大麻素可能造成心跳急促、躁动、呕吐、混乱、癫痫发作与精神病。

fact.en: Like several synthetic cannabinoids, it began as a Pfizer painkiller candidate described in a 2009 patent, was shelved, and later reappeared on the designer drug market.
fact.zh: 和多種合成大麻素一樣，它最初是輝瑞在 2009 年專利中描述的止痛藥候選物，後來被擱置，之後又重新出現在設計師藥物市場上。
fact.zhHans: 和多种合成大麻素一样，它最初是辉瑞在 2009 年专利中描述的止痛药候选物，后来被搁置，之后又重新出现在设计师药物市场上。
